note: A candidate replacement for reusable Battle Plans and the reference-only Command card. Do not use with the current one-page rulebook until the order-draw economy is approved.
used_for: One hidden, army-wide tactical choice revealed before rolling the D6.

orders.title: Assault
orders.effect: Advance one surviving Force one empty rank forward in each Front.

orders.title: Hold
orders.effect: Withdraw one Force one empty rank per Front. Your Defend results can protect any ally in that Front.

orders.title: Volley
orders.effect: Your Archers may Attack any enemy in their Front, including Middle or Rear.

orders.title: Raid
orders.effect: Move one Raider, Rider or Skirmisher per Front sideways into an empty same-rank space in an adjacent open Front. They may Attack enemy Middle or Rear.
